name: rosetta-department-numbers
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

// Police, sanitation and fire each take a different number from 1 to 7, the
// police number is even, and the three sum to 12.

write_line("police sanitation fire")

for police in [2, 4, 6] do
    for sanitation in 1::7 do
        let fire = 12 - police - sanitation

        if
            fire >= 1 /\ fire <= 7 /\
            sanitation != police /\ fire != police /\ fire != sanitation
        then
            write_line("{police,6} {sanitation,10} {fire,4}")
        fi
    od
od

use IO.Std.write_line

// Police, sanitation and fire each take a different number from 1 to 7, the
// police number is even, and the three sum to 12.

write_line("police sanitation fire")

for police in [2, 4, 6] do
    for sanitation in 1::7 do
        let fire = 12 - police - sanitation

        if
            fire >= 1 /\ fire <= 7 /\
            sanitation != police /\ fire != police /\ fire != sanitation
        then
            write_line("{police,6} {sanitation,10} {fire,4}")
        fi
    od
od
